sources.title: ICML Poster AgentExpt: Automating AI Experiment Design with LLM-based ...
sources.snippet: We built an AI assistant trained on over 100,000 published AI papers to learn how scientists actually conduct experiments in the real world. Instead of just matching keywords, our tool looks at "collective perception"—how the scientific community actually talks about and uses these datasets and baselines in practice.
